newsitem.title: USA: Global Village unveils new modem.
newsitem.headline: Global Village unveils new modem.

text.p: Global Village Communication Monday announced plans to sell its first modem product for the Windows market called TelePort 33.6 Speakerphone modem for Windows.
In a statement, the company said the product is Global Village's third major new Windows product introduction in less than six months.

"The TelePort Speakerphone modem is the first product to give customers a high-speed modem combined with a professional-quality, standalone speakerphone," said Neil Selvin, president and chief executive officer of Global Village Communication. "Unlike all other competitive products that wholly depend on the computer to be turned on, we've taken a new approach to speakerphone modems that allows our speakerphone to operate whether the computer is on or off.
TelePort 33.6 Speakerphone modem is expected to ship on Nov. 11 with an estimated street price of $239 and will be available through leading retail stores and catalogues.
